directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired

targets.baseline_commit_message: grade-and-repair-speech-audio: byte copies of the speech-grading plan reader and the voice-take checks (port baseline)

preserve: each word, 60 ms either side, gets earshot realness and a match against a glitch and the voice wanted
each word's realness and glitch match are ranked against the take's own median and spread
the five least real and the five most glitch-like words are printed
allowed_deltas: the voice wanted is the person's words, an argument, instead of a description written in the code
banned_substitutions: a model other than earshot's listening calls
a fixed description of the voice
_old_copy: The old copy leaves the private repository on its own branch once the Mac parity run (out/speech/mac-parity) says EQUAL.
